findings.title: Store-parser non-finite guards in flow_lift, tariff, price_model survive deletion: no gate driver notices
findings.claim: Deleting any of four isfinite guards in persisted-state parsers (flow_lift.py:210, tariff.py:402, price_model.py:324, price_model.py:349) leaves every driver of the file's measured closure, env_drift --all included, green, although each mutant restores corrupt stored values as live state.
findings.mechanism: The corrupt-payload checks in tests/features.py feed only unparseable strings, None or over-range finite values; none feeds a string float() accepts as non-finite ('nan','inf') or a negative sample count, which are exactly the inputs these guards exist for.

findings.title: PriceShapeModel residual_var restore can discard every stored variance with the gate green
findings.claim: Replacing price_model.py:368's max(0.0, float(v)) with 0.0 zeroes every restored residual variance, and all 15 closure drivers (env_drift --all included) stay green.
findings.mechanism: The only residual_var load check (tests/features.py:41446) feeds a corrupt 'x' payload and compares to a fresh (all-zero) model, which the mutant also satisfies; no positive-control round trip (learned -> as_dict -> from_dict) asserts a variance survives a restart.
